messages:
mel_ops: Vendor pinged 1: shipment delayed in customs, offering split: 5 H100 air now + remaining 20 H100 sea next week. Need quick decision on air for hot replacements.

vendor_tom: Correct. Air available for 5 units at +$1.1k/unit expedited fee. We can include preprinted RMA labels and photo checklist. If you take the surcharge we can prepay duties for the air shipment (+$400 flat).

lina_finance: +$5.5k surcharge is acceptable as emergency this quarter but PO amend required. We prefer vendor cover 30% insurance; we'll take 70%. Add duty prepay line to invoice.

dan_sre: eu-west cluster has 3 degraded hosts and one full rack with NVLink fault. If we get 5 early, route them to NVLink rack first. Depot slot can handle 6 crates Tue AM. Need crate packing spec and serials on AWB.

logistics-bot: manifest uploaded: https://shipments.vendorco.com/manifest/ZZ2025 1 AWB preview XY-555-01.

mel_ops: OK proceed: air 5 now, sea 20. vendor_tom, confirm AWB will include original serials and RMA labels in crates and a 7-day DOA booking SLA. Also update manifest link in thread when live.

vendor_tom: ack. AWB XY-555-01 will include original serials, RMA labels in crates, and photo checklist. 7-day DOA booking SLA for air units confirmed. Will push final docs by EOD.

lina_finance: ack 1 initiating PO amendment. Put emergency code in description.

mel_ops: thanks 1 ops ticket OPS-4781 opened for surge budget and maintenance windows. Reply "ack" when docs live.
